critical_path_summary.staffing_implication: Product Manager and Backend Developer must be dedicated (not shared) across all phases; Frontend Developer and UX Designer can be partially shared with other projects during Phase 4-5 non-critical tasks.

phases.name: Discovery & Design
milestones: Stakeholder alignment session completed and scope signed off
User personas and success metrics defined
Architecture and data retention policy approved
Requirements finalized and design mockups approved

tasks.name: Conduct stakeholder alignment session and document scope sign-off
tasks.definition_of_done: Scope document signed by CEO, HR Director, and IT Director; all hard constraints and assumptions documented.

tasks.name: Define user personas, success metrics, and adoption plan for new hires and HR team
tasks.definition_of_done: Personas document with 3+ new hire archetypes; success metrics tied to business goals; adoption plan with communication timeline.

tasks.name: Confirm Workday API sandbox availability, Azure AD permissions, e-signature vendor compliance, and data retention policy with stakeholders
tasks.definition_of_done: Written confirmation from Workday, IT Director, Legal, and Compliance on all four assumptions (A1-A4); any blockers escalated and mitigation plan documented.

tasks.name: Create system architecture diagram and database schema for onboarding portal with data retention logic
tasks.definition_of_done: Architecture diagram approved by Tech Lead; PostgreSQL schema includes audit log tables and retention policy columns; SOC 2 compliance checklist addressed.

tasks.name: Design UI mockups and user flows for onboarding checklist, document submission, and team introduction screens
tasks.definition_of_done: Figma mockups for all 5 primary screens; user flows validated with 2+ HR stakeholders; accessibility checklist (WCAG 2.1 AA) initiated.

tasks.name: Write API specification for onboarding endpoints (checklist, documents, team, audit logs)
tasks.definition_of_done: OpenAPI 3.0 spec with all endpoints, request/response schemas, and error codes; reviewed by Frontend Developer.

tasks.name: Set up development environment, CI/CD pipeline, and Azure App Service infrastructure
tasks.definition_of_done: GitHub repo created; Azure App Service staging and production slots configured; CI/CD pipeline deploys on commit; all team members can run local dev environment.

phases.name: Core Development (Sprint Cycles)
milestones: Sprint 1: Onboarding checklist and team introduction UI complete
Sprint 2: Azure AD SSO authentication and user profile management complete
Sprint 3: Document submission and e-signature integration complete
Sprint 4: Workday API integration and form pre-population complete
Sprint 5: Internal demo with HR team; core features working end-to-end

tasks.name: Build React frontend for onboarding checklist and task tracking UI
tasks.definition_of_done: Checklist displays all 8 onboarding tasks with due dates; task completion state persists; responsive design tested on mobile and desktop.

tasks.name: Build React frontend for team introduction screen with member profiles and photos
tasks.definition_of_done: Team member profiles display name, role, photo, and bio; search and filter by department functional; accessibility audit passed.

tasks.name: Implement Azure AD SSO authentication and session management
tasks.definition_of_done: New hires can log in via Azure AD; session tokens validated on every API call; logout clears session; tested with 3+ Azure AD test accounts.

tasks.name: Build user profile management API and database schema for new hire data
tasks.definition_of_done: API endpoints for GET/POST user profile; PostgreSQL user table with audit columns; data validation and error handling complete.

tasks.name: Build React frontend for document submission and e-signature workflow
tasks.definition_of_done: Document upload form for I-9, W-4, direct deposit; e-signature widget embedded; submission confirmation and status tracking functional.

tasks.name: Integrate e-signature service API for document signing and compliance tracking
tasks.definition_of_done: Documents sent to e-signature service; signed documents retrieved and stored; audit trail captured; SOC 2 compliance checklist updated.

tasks.name: Build Workday API integration for employee data retrieval and form pre-population
tasks.definition_of_done: API calls to Workday sandbox retrieve new hire name, email, department, start date; form fields pre-populated; error handling for API failures.

tasks.name: Implement audit logging for all document submissions and user actions
tasks.definition_of_done: Audit log table records timestamp, user ID, action type, and document ID for all submissions; logs immutable and retained per policy; SOC 2 requirement met.

tasks.name: Build HR admin dashboard for monitoring new hire task completion and document status
tasks.definition_of_done: Dashboard displays list of new hires with task completion percentage; document submission status; filter by cohort and start date; export to CSV.

tasks.name: Conduct internal demo with HR team and gather feedback on core features
tasks.definition_of_done: Demo covers all 5 primary use cases; HR team provides written feedback; scope change requests logged and prioritized; go/no-go decision documented.

phases.name: Integration & Edge Cases (Sprint Cycles)
milestones: Sprint 6: IT account provisioning automation via Azure AD complete
Sprint 7: Edge cases and error handling complete; security review initiated
All integrations tested end-to-end; security review completed

tasks.name: Implement Azure AD account provisioning automation for email, Slack, and SaaS tools
tasks.definition_of_done: IT admin triggers account creation; Azure AD Graph API creates user account; email, Slack, and SaaS provisioning automated; rollback procedure documented.

tasks.name: Build IT admin interface for account provisioning approval and status tracking
tasks.definition_of_done: IT admin can view pending account requests; approve/reject with comments; track provisioning status; receive notifications on completion.

tasks.name: Test Workday API integration with sandbox data and handle API failures gracefully
tasks.definition_of_done: Integration tested with 10+ sandbox employee records; API timeout and error responses handled; fallback to manual data entry functional; logging complete.

tasks.name: Test e-signature integration end-to-end with real document workflows
tasks.definition_of_done: Documents signed and retrieved from e-signature service; signed PDFs stored securely; audit trail complete; compliance verified.

tasks.name: Implement error handling and edge cases for missing data, API failures, and network timeouts
tasks.definition_of_done: All API calls have retry logic; user-facing error messages clear and actionable; logging captures all failures; tested with chaos engineering scenarios.

tasks.name: Conduct security review and penetration testing for SOC 2 compliance
tasks.definition_of_done: Security audit completed by external firm; vulnerabilities identified and remediated; SOC 2 Type II readiness confirmed; compliance report generated.

tasks.name: Test accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.1 AA) across all screens and workflows
tasks.definition_of_done: Automated accessibility scan passed; manual testing with screen reader completed; color contrast verified; keyboard navigation functional.

tasks.name: Conduct integration testing across all external APIs (Workday, Azure AD, e-signature) in staging environment
tasks.definition_of_done: All integrations tested end-to-end in staging; data flows correctly between systems; audit logs capture all transactions; no data loss or corruption.

phases.name: QA & Testing
milestones: UAT completed with HR team and new hire representatives

tasks.name: Execute comprehensive functional testing across all use cases and user workflows
tasks.definition_of_done: Test cases written for all 8 use cases; 95%+ pass rate; critical bugs logged and prioritized; regression testing completed.

tasks.name: Conduct user acceptance testing (UAT) with HR team and 3+ new hire representatives
tasks.definition_of_done: UAT script executed with real users; feedback documented; satisfaction survey completed; sign-off obtained from HR Director and IT Director.

tasks.name: Perform load testing and performance optimization for 200+ concurrent new hires
tasks.definition_of_done: Load test simulates 200 concurrent users; response times < 2 seconds; database queries optimized; caching implemented where applicable.

tasks.name: Resolve all critical and high-priority bugs identified during testing and UAT
tasks.definition_of_done: All P0 and P1 bugs fixed and verified; regression testing passed; release notes prepared; ready for production deployment.

tasks.name: Write technical documentation, runbooks, and operational procedures for HR and IT teams
tasks.definition_of_done: Runbooks cover account provisioning, document submission, troubleshooting, and escalation procedures; training materials prepared; video walkthroughs recorded.

tasks.name: Create adoption and communication plan for new hire onboarding and HR team training
tasks.definition_of_done: Communication timeline established; HR team training scheduled; new hire email template drafted; FAQ document prepared; post-launch support plan defined.

tasks.name: Deploy application to Azure App Service production environment
tasks.definition_of_done: Code deployed to production; database migrations applied; environment variables configured; rollback procedure tested and documented.

tasks.name: Execute smoke testing in production and verify all critical workflows functional
tasks.definition_of_done: Smoke test checklist executed; all 8 use cases verified in production; no critical issues found; monitoring and alerting active.

tasks.name: Obtain go-live sign-off from CEO, HR Director, and IT Director
tasks.definition_of_done: Written sign-off obtained from all three stakeholders; go-live date confirmed; post-launch support escalation procedures activated.
